kept_files.reason: Deep enough: the pure core of a Secret (Name, Kind, Values, Field, Fault) and the decisions put/get/env/list make on it behind a few functions (parse_set/parse_meta/stdin_value/pipe_field for put's inputs, merge, value, to_json/summary, exports), each doing real work (merge finds every fault at once and upserts Fields in order). Callers in commands.rs/item.rs/store.rs use only that interface; tests reach no private helper. Size is ~60 lines of Fault docs (the manual's refusal table) plus refusal wording; churn is features adding inputs and faults to the domain core, which belong here. Splitting put's input parsing out would spread one concept over two modules for no leverage.
